review_risk: Self-review could be mistaken for independent validation.
review_floor: Record reviewer relationship to implementer, sponsor, vendor, candidate, party, advocacy group, and publication operator before any independent-review claim.
required_records: reviewer identity; affiliation; scope; independence statement; exclusions; approver
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; no independent reviewer named
public_boundary: A review is not independent until scope and relationships are disclosed.
non_claims: not third-party validation; not certification; not legal advice

review_risk: Financial, employment, political, vendor, litigation, or public-advocacy conflicts may bias review conclusions or public interpretation.
review_floor: Collect disclosed conflicts, non-disclosure attestation, mitigation, recusal, and unresolved-conflict status.
required_records: COI disclosure; mitigation plan; recusal rule; unresolved-conflict note; expiry date
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; no COI disclosures in archive
public_boundary: Undisclosed or unresolved conflicts must be visible before relying on review output; this is not certification or live-pilot authorization.
non_claims: not proof of impartiality; not ethics clearance; not legal advice

review_risk: Reviewer credentials may be overclaimed or outside the reviewed domain.
review_floor: Record domain competence, methods allowed, methods excluded, time budget, evidence access limits, and uncertainty boundaries.
required_records: qualification note; method limits; evidence access level; out-of-scope list; uncertainty statement
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; no reviewer qualifications in archive
public_boundary: A bounded review may support a specific claim only inside its stated methods and limits; this is not certification or live-pilot authorization.
non_claims: not certification; not complete security audit; not legal advice

review_risk: Cherry-picked packets or scenarios could hide failures while appearing reviewed.
review_floor: Pre-register which artifacts, scenarios, negative controls, source rows, and reports are included or excluded.
required_records: artifact list; sample rule; exclusion rationale; random seed if used; reviewer signoff
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; selection plan not externally reviewed
public_boundary: Review scope must be reproducible before PASS language is reused outside rehearsal; this is not certification or live-pilot authorization.
non_claims: not live deployment evidence; not outcome proof; not fraud proof

review_risk: A reviewer may not be able to reproduce maintainer results offline.
review_floor: Preserve commands, release ZIP hash, extraction path, environment notes, start/end time, verifier outputs, and failures.
required_records: transcript; ZIP sha256; command log; environment note; failure appendix
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; no external transcript in archive
public_boundary: Independent review needs a preserved reproduction record, not only a PASS assertion.
non_claims: not live certification; not chain-of-custody certification; not legal advice

review_risk: Disagreement could be suppressed or summarized away.
review_floor: Provide a dissent channel, minority-report pointer, unresolved issue list, and publication rule for disagreements.
required_records: dissent pointer; issue IDs; owner; deadline; safe public sentence
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; no external dissent channel exercised
public_boundary: Reviewer disagreement is evidence that must be preserved and bounded, not hidden.
non_claims: not proof that a dissent is correct; not proof of intent; not legal advice

review_risk: Public summaries can turn limited review into overbroad validation language.
review_floor: Require reviewer approval of public wording, non-claims, unresolved issue summary, and scope limits before publication.
required_records: approved public summary; non-claim checklist; unresolved issue summary; signer; date
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; no public reviewer approval
public_boundary: Public review language must not imply certification, legal status, or live readiness beyond evidence.
non_claims: not public-release authorization; not current voter instruction; not certification

review_risk: Reviewers may see private, sealed, safety-sensitive, or security-sensitive details.
review_floor: Record access class, minimization rule, safe-contact route, doxxing/safety risk, and redaction constraints.
required_records: access class; private-field access; safety notes; redaction agreement; escalation route
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; no reviewer private-data access authorized
public_boundary: Independent review must not become a privacy or safety leak.
non_claims: not public-records ruling; not legal advice; not authorization to disclose private data

review_risk: Challenge sessions can become unsafe, undisclosed, or confused with permission to attack live systems.
review_floor: Define allowed targets, prohibited targets, test windows, rate limits, disclosure route, and stop conditions.
required_records: challenge scope; authorization; prohibited targets; disclosure route; stop condition
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; no live challenge authorization
public_boundary: Adversarial review needs written authorization and safety bounds before any live contact; this is not certification or live-pilot authorization.
non_claims: not authorization to test live systems; not legal advice; not proof of attack-free status

review_risk: Independent reviewers may write conclusions that look like legal opinions, records rulings, or admissibility determinations.
review_floor: Record counsel/records routing, prohibited legal phrases, legal-use boundary, and who may approve court-facing language.
required_records: legal boundary note; records route; prohibited phrases; reviewer signoff; escalation owner
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; no legal review in archive
public_boundary: Review output must preserve evidence without becoming an unauthorized legal conclusion; this is not certification or live-pilot authorization.
non_claims: not admissibility opinion; not public-records ruling; not legal advice

review_risk: Reviewer access can break custody/provenance assumptions or leak sealed material.
review_floor: Log evidence provided to reviewers, access time, sealed/private fields, transfer digest, and return/destruction rule.
required_records: access log; transfer digest; sealed material note; return/destruction record; exception
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; no reviewer access log
public_boundary: Reviewer access is part of custody and must be recorded before live reliance; this is not certification or live-pilot authorization.
non_claims: not chain-of-custody certification; not admissibility opinion; not legal advice

review_risk: Fixes may be asserted without independent retest or regression checks.
review_floor: For each finding, record fix owner, changed artifact, retest command, old/new result, residual risk, and closure decision.
required_records: finding ID; remediation owner; retest transcript; residual risk; closure signer
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; no external findings closed
public_boundary: A fixed issue is not closed until retest evidence and residual risk are recorded.
non_claims: not proof that no issues remain; not certification; not legal advice

review_risk: Readers may misread external review as endorsement, certification, or live authorization.
review_floor: Attach explicit non-claims to every external-review summary and require reviewer approval of public boundary wording.
required_records: public boundary; reviewer approval; non-claim list; live-use warning; contact for corrections
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; public non-claims not externally approved
public_boundary: External-review summaries must carry scope limits and non-certification language; this is not certification or live-pilot authorization.
non_claims: not endorsement; not certification; not live authorization; not legal advice

review_risk: The archive could promote itself from self-tested to externally validated without evidence.
review_floor: Keep independent-validation and live-pilot claims no-go until every applicable review row has local evidence or accountable exception.
required_records: closed matrix; named reviewers; unresolved issues; exceptions; approval date
synthetic_status: synthetic placeholder only; gate remains no-go
public_boundary: Self-verification plus synthetic examples are not independent review.
non_claims: not third-party validation; not live pilot approval; not certification; not legal advice
